name: FUN_TRANSFERS
description: This is a temporary table that is used by the Intercompany Transfer to General Ledger, Intercompany Transfer to Payables, and Intercompany Transfer to Receivables processes.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: BATCH_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the batch.

columns.name: BATCH_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned to the intercompany batch.

columns.name: TRX_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the transaction.

columns.name: TRX_NUMBER
columns.description: Number of the transaction in the batch.

columns.name: LEDGER_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the ledger.

columns.name: LEDGER_NAME
columns.description: Name of the ledger the intercompany batch will be posted to.

columns.name: PARTY_TYPE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag indicating the party type of the row when transferring intercompany transactions

columns.name: PROCESS_MESG
columns.description: Status of the intercompany row being processed.

columns.name: PERIOD_NAME
columns.description: Name of the period for the intercompany transfer.

columns.name: BU_ID
columns.description: Unique system generated identifier for the business unit.
